caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular area with a quilted, diamond-patterned, grey background. In the upper left portion, there is a curved draped element with alternating light and dark grey stripes, resembling fabric. Scattered across the patterned background are clusters of flowers: most are red with small round petals, some are white, and all have green foliage. The flower clusters are distributed along the right edge and across the lower and central part of the composition. The background pattern is marked throughout with black lines forming a lattice effect. The drawing is bordered by an unembellished, off-white margin, and there is a small inscription with the name “Elizabeth T. Keiser” in the lower right corner. Red numbers and letters are faintly visible in the bottom left margin.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
